summary.en: Slide tiles, merge matching numbers and chase the 2048 tile — the viral puzzle that became H5 gaming's Hello World.
summary.zh: 风靡全球的数字合并游戏，H5 小游戏的「Hello World」，代码短得可以逐行读完。

description.en: Gabriele Cirulli's original 2048 — the game that kicked off a hundred clones. Written in vanilla JavaScript with zero build step, MIT-licensed, and still the reference implementation for puzzle-game clarity.
description.zh: 4×4 棋盘，方向键滑动，相同数字碰撞合并，每次移动随机生成 2 或 4。凑出 2048 即通关，也可以继续玩到棋盘填满为止。

howto.en: Arrow keys or WASD; swipe on mobile. Matching numbers merge when they collide.
howto.zh: 电脑端方向键或 WASD；手机端滑动手势。相同数字碰撞合并升级。

tip.en: Re-skinning costs almost nothing: change the CSS palette and the title and it becomes your own brand. Touch events ship built in with smooth gestures — the single best opener for driving traffic.
tip.zh: 改皮肤成本极低：只改 CSS 配色 + 替换标题就能变成自有品牌。移动端 touch 事件已内置，手势流畅，是做站引流的最佳开局游戏。
